YT-zen Options

Client-Side Configuration and Settings Manager

Setting Up YT-zen

YT-zen settings are configured directly inside the YouTube webpage dashboard interface. To access your configurations:

1. Open YouTube in a new tab.

2. Locate and click the YT-zen settings button on the video player or settings bar, or press the settings shortcut.

3. Any settings you configure inside the YouTube page are automatically synchronized in real-time across all other open tabs and windows!
